processing.boundaries: modern sample length may end before source gate; no looping or padding to invent a cry
processing.chorus: two simultaneous source-tuned tracks; signed conversion and 7-bit wrap retained
processing.headroom: fixed 0.5 before each resampler; restore in wide accumulation; attenuation only if mixed peak exceeds -3dBFS
processing.level: source volume ratio retained; do not normalize each mode back to equal RMS
processing.limitations: not the GBA compressed decoder, integer mixer, reverb or frame-phase output; emulator A/B and listening remain required
processing.pitch: source integer MIDI frequency tables, rounded asetrate then SWR 48k; speed changes with pitch
processing.release: 255-level recurrence (level * release) >> 8 per GBA frame after note gate; interpolate gain over each frame to avoid steps
processing.reverse: reverse modern decoded sample before resampling, no invented echo delay
